text: For a continuous vector field on an open time-state domain, locally Lipschitz in the state variable uniformly in time, the initial-value problem has a local solution with the prescribed initial state and derivative equal to that vector field.
selected_scope: Local existence and derivative equation component only; uniqueness and manifold pushforward conventions are not silently added. Whether a raw tangent-space representation gives the same field in the coordinate chart is a separate scope check.
